paite: Pathian min leh athuhilhna thu gensiat a a-omlouhna ding in sikha hakkol bat peuhmahte'n amau pute bangkim ah zahtak tham in sim uhen.
heading: Sikhate

paite: Huan gingtami pu a neite'n unau ahih ziak un ngaineu kei uhen, himahleh phattuamna mute leh deihtakte ahih ziak un a-nna uh sepsak semsem uhen. Huai thute hilh inla, hanthawn in.
Mi kuapeuh in thuhilhna dang ahilh a, thutak, i Toupa Jesu Khrist thu leh Pathian limsak lam thuhilhna hoih asak keileh,
heading: Sinsaktu Dikloute

paite: amah kisathei ahi a, bangmah thei lou ahi, theih nak sang in kisel leh thukalh lam ah ahai zawta a, huchibang a kipan in, enna, kilaina, gensiatna,
hoih lou lam a ginna, selhatna asuak nak hi; huchibang mi lungsim sia neite'n thutak nei lou in, Pathian limsak pen punna khattou asa uhi.
Himahleh lungkimna toh kithuah Pathian limsakna tuh punna thupitak ahi.
heading: Hauhsakna Dik

paite: Khovel ah bangmah i lutpih kei a, bangmah i pawtpih thei sam kei ding hi.
Himahleh nek ding leh silh ding nei in, huaite ah i lungkim ding uhi.
Himahleh, hauhsak tumte khemna, thang, haihuai leh hihse thei duhgawlna tampi ah apuklut nak uhi, huaite'n tuh siatna leh manthatna ah mite ahihtum nak uhi.
Dangka sum deihtak zaw gilou chiteng bul ahi; khenkhatte'n a-eng ua, ginna apaimangsan ua, amau leh amau lungkhamna tampi in akisunlet tektok uhi.
Himahleh nang Pathian mipa aw, huai thilte taisan inla, diktatna, Pathian limsakna, ginna, itna, thuaktheihna, kingaihniamnate delh in.
heading: Mimal Kihilhnate

paite: Ginna kidouna hoih dou inla, tangtawn hinna len tinten in; huai tang ding a sap na hi a; theihpih tamtakte mitmuh in gupna hoih na gumta hi.
Pathian thil bangkim hihhingpa leh Khrist Jesu, Pontias Pilat mai a gupna hoih gumpa mitmuh in thu ka hon pia hi;
Toupa Jesu Khrist hong kilat nawn masiah huai thupiak siangthou leh gensiatbei a kem ding in.
Huai kilakna ama huntak ah phat tuak thuneipa tak kia, kumpipate' Kumpipa, toupate' Toupa'n alak ding ahi.

Amah kia in sih theihlouhna anei a, vak naih theih vual louh ah a-om a, amah kuamah in amu ngei kei ua, muh leng amu thei sam kei uhi; amah kiang ah tangtawn in thupina leh thilhihtheihna om hen, Amen.
Hiai khovel a mihausate kisathei lou ding leh hauhna kip lou a muanna nga lou a, thil tengteng kipahna ding a tampi a hon pepa Pathian a nga zaw ding in hilh in.
Thil hoih ahih ding uh, thil hoih hih a ahauh ding uh, thilphal a asiam ding uh ahi.
Huchi a amau a ding a gou kikhol a, tunung a dia suangphum hoih phum a, tangtawn hinna taktak aletkip theihna ding un.
Timothi aw, na kiang a kepsak a om kemhoih in; Pathian zah louh thugen mawkmawk leh kikalhna dikloupi a pilna kichite nungngatsan in;
mi khenkhat in huai nei kichi in ginna ah apaikhial uhi. Hehpihna na kiang ah om hen, Amen.
